headword: {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}

definitions.gloss: relationship of trust; trusting relationship; bond of trust
definitions.explanation: A relationship between people, organizations, or nations that is built on mutual trust and reliability.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: To build a relationship of trust.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: A trusting relationship between boss and subordinate is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧{信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's not easy to restore a relationship of trust once it has been broken.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common compound in business, education, interpersonal, and diplomatic contexts. Often discussed as something that takes time to build but can be quickly destroyed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧ (to build a trusting relationship)
- {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ (to destroy a trusting relationship)
- {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧ (a trusting relationship crumbles)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧: trust, credit — focuses on credibility and reliability, often financial
- ⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧: bond, ties — emphasizes emotional connection rather than trust specifically
